text: A trail guide pins a hand-drawn map to the lounge wall: the ridge trail, best walked at sunrise before the campers are up.
For the third evening running, someone else is sitting at the end of the dock after lights out. Tonight they wave you over. (Placeholder: the chance route's first meeting.)
The sailing instructor asks whether you would take a turn on the boathouse roster next week. You say yes before thinking about it.
